description: Offline prompt set for effort-budget proxy evaluation; no provider calls.

cases.prompt: Define a hash table in one sentence.
Explain how a database index speeds up a query, and give a brief example using a customer table.
Summarize the purpose of a message queue and list two common use cases in short bullet points.
Compare breadth-first and depth-first traversal for a cyclic graph, derive their time and space complexity, and recommend one for finding shortest paths.
Debug this concurrency scenario: identify the race condition, explain its cause, and propose a test that would reliably reproduce it.
